blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep learning has become the default tool for medical image analysis, driven by the open-source movement. However, achieving the best performance on a given task remains difficult, with architecture selection and hyperparameter optimization (HPO) still considered "more of an art than a science". Automated machine learning (AutoML) automates parts of model training, yet helps little in medical imaging: general-purpose approaches lack medical architectures and preprocessing, and medical-focused ones demand engineering expertise and remain confined to narrow tasks such as 3D segmentation. We introduce MedicalMLOmni, a multi-agent AutoML framework that automates model training for diverse single- and multi-modal medical tasks through a natural language interface. Specifically, MedicalMLOmni performs evidence-based planning by retrieving published results to guide model selection and configuration, and employs parallel HPO where multiple agents explore adjustment strategies concurrently. MedicalMLOmni achieves the best score on 19 of 20 benchmarks; PMC-VQA is the exception, where a vision-language model with broader pre-training leads. Backbone-matched controls attribute the gains to the framework, not the backbone. By removing coding requirements, MedicalMLOmni lowers the barrier for domain experts with rich datasets but limited engineering expertise.
blocks.zh: 深层学习已经成为医学图像分析的默认工具,由开源运动驱动. 然而,在特定任务上实现最佳表现仍然是困难的,建筑选择和超参数优化(HPO)仍然被认为是"更多的艺术而不是科学". 自动化机器学习(AutoML)将模型培训的部分自动化,然而在医学成像方面帮助甚微:通用方法缺乏医疗架构和预处理,以医学为重点的方法需要工程专业知识,仍然局限于3D分割等狭义任务. 我们引入了MedicalMLOmni,这是一个多代理AutoML框架,通过自然语言界面,将多种单式和多式医疗任务的模型培训自动化. 具体而言,MedicalMLOmni通过检索公布的结果来进行循证规划,以指导模型选择和配置,并采用平行的HPO,由多个代理人同时探索调整策略. MedicalMLOmni在20个基准中的19个基准上取得了最佳得分;PMC-VQA是例外,其中视觉语言模型具有更广泛的培训前领先. 后骨匹配控制将收益归结于框架,而不是骨干. 通过取消编码要求,MedicalMLOmni降低了对拥有丰富数据集但工程专业知识有限的域专家的屏障.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Medical image analysis relies heavily on deep learning (DL).
However, deploying DL models for new clinical sites typically requires retraining with architecture modifications, custom preprocessing, and hyperparameter optimization (HPO) due to anatomical variability and protocol differences between institutions [ 39 ] .
This process demands considerable time and expertise, limiting clinical adoption [ 41 ] .
Automated machine learning (AutoML) was therefore introduced to eliminate manual effort by automatically training DL models for new tasks.
General-purpose AutoML methods such as AutoGluon [ 40 ] and AutoKeras [ 21 ] lack medical-specific preprocessing and model architectures.
Medical-focused AutoML methods like Auto3DSeg partially address these gaps by configuring preprocessing and selecting medical-specific architectures based on dataset properties [ 7 ] .
However, these approaches remain limited to specific scopes such as 3D segmentation, excluding other tasks like multi-modal fusion.
Most AutoML methods also require coding knowledge to operate, creating barriers for clinical users [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh:
医学图像分析在很大程度上依赖于深层学习(DL).
然而,为新的临床场所部署DL模型通常需要再培训,并进行建筑改造、定制预处理和超参数优化(HPO),因为各机构之间的解剖变化和协议差异[39]。
这一过程需要相当长的时间和专门知识,限制了临床的采纳[41].
因此,采用了自动机器学习(AutoML),通过为新任务自动培训DL模型来消除人工操作.
AutoGluon[40]和AutoKeras[21]等通用自动ML方法缺乏医学专用的预处理和模型架构.
Auto3DSeg等注重医学的自动ML方法通过根据数据集属性配置预处理和选择医学特异性架构来部分弥补这些差距[7].
然而,这些方法仍然局限于三维分离等具体范围,不包括其他任务,如多式联运。
大多数AutoML方法也要求使用编码知识,为临床使用者制造障碍[32].

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) address these limitations through multi-agent systems that generate executable ML pipelines from natural language task descriptions without manual coding.
For example, AutoM3L [ 32 ] employs LLMs to identify data and task types and generate corresponding DL training pipelines.
MLZero [ 9 ] extends this approach with memory to reuse past experiences in similar problems.
However, these general-purpose AutoML agents lack medical knowledge and cannot select appropriate DL architectures or configurations for clinical applications.
Existing AutoML agents also configure hyperparameters through optimization methods such as Bayesian optimization [ 40 , 32 ] , without drawing on domain-specific knowledge from the literature.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMS)通过多代理系统解决这些局限性,这些系统从自然语言任务描述中生成可执行的ML管道而无需手动编码.
例如,AutoM3L[32]使用LLMs来识别数据和任务类型,并生成相应的DL培训管道.
MLZero [9] 将这一方法与内存一起延伸至在类似问题上重新利用过去的经验。
然而,这些通用自动ML剂缺乏医学知识,无法选择适当的DL架构或配置进行临床应用.
现有的AutoML代理也通过优化方法配置超参数,如Bayesian优化[40,32],而不借鉴文献中针对域的知识.

blocks.en:
We introduce MedicalMLOmni, a multi-agent AutoML framework for medical applications.
Multi-agent automation of medical model development is itself an active area [ 10 , 42 , 46 , 38 , 31 ] .
What distinguishes MedicalMLOmni is therefore the source of its configuration decisions, as Tab. 1 summarizes.
MedicalMLOmni supports diverse uni-/multi-modal tasks such as visual question answering (VQA) and segmentation through an extensible architecture that adapts to new task formulations.
MedicalMLOmni operates in two stages, where the planning stage analyzes the data and the user’s query, while the execution stage implements the generated workflow.
Specifically, MedicalMLOmni performs evidence-based planning by searching the medical literature online, grounding model selection and hyperparameter configuration in published results rather than templates, presets, or the LLM’s own prior.
For the execution stage, MedicalMLOmni employs parallel reasoning for efficient HPO, where each agent independently explores hyperparameter adjustment strategies from the literature before aggregation.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了MedicanMLOmni,用于医疗应用的多代理自动ML框架.
医疗模型开发的多剂自动化本身是一个活跃领域[10,42,46,38,31].
因此,正如Tab. 1所总结的那样,MedicalMLOmni的区别是其配置决定的来源。
MedicalMLOmni通过适应新任务配方的可扩展架构,支持多种单式/多式任务,如视觉问答(VQA)和分割.
MedicalMLOmni分两个阶段运作,其中规划阶段分析数据和用户的查询,而执行阶段则执行生成的工作流程.
MedicalMLOmni通过在线搜索医学文献、在公布的结果中定位模型选择和超参数配置,
对于执行阶段,MedicalMLOmni对高效HPO采用平行推理,其中每个代理在汇总前从文献中独立探索超参数调整策略.

blocks.en:
The major contributions are threefold.
First, we introduce a medical-specific multi-agent AutoML framework that automates DL model training for diverse tasks through natural language interfaces.
Second, we propose evidence-based planning that retrieves information from literature to inform architecture and configuration decisions.
Finally, we introduce parallel reasoning for more efficient HPO where multiple agents independently explore adjustment strategies before aggregation.
To isolate what the framework contributes, we further report a backbone-matched control, a domain-expert baseline, a retrieval-reproducibility study, and a contamination-controlled protocol that excludes benchmark-specific sources from retrieval.
blocks.zh:
主要贡献有三。
首先,我们引入了医学专用的多剂AutoML框架,通过自然语言界面,将DL模型培训自动化,以完成多种任务.
第二,我们提出循证规划,从文献中检索信息,为架构和配置决定提供信息。
最后,我们提出了提高效率的平行理由,即多重代理人在汇总之前独立探讨调整战略。
为了孤立框架的贡献,我们进一步报告一个与主干匹配的控制、一个域-专家基线、一个检索-可复制性研究,以及一个排除特定基准源的污染控制协议。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
General-purpose AutoML frameworks such as AutoGluon [ 40 ] and AutoKeras [ 21 ] search over model families and hyperparameters through Bayesian or evolutionary optimization.
AutoM3L [ 32 ] and MLZero [ 9 ] replace that search with an LLM that reads a task description and emits a training pipeline.
These systems are domain-agnostic, so the architectures, preprocessing, and loss functions they reach are those of the general vision and tabular literature.
blocks.zh:
AutoGluon[40]和AutoKeras[21]等通用自动ML框架通过巴伊西亚或进化优化搜索模型家族和超参数.
AutoM3L [32] 和 MLZero [9] 以读取任务描述并发射培训管道的LLM代替搜索.
这些系统是域不可知的,所以它们所触及的架构,预处理和丢失功能都是一般视觉和表格文献的功能.

blocks.en:
Several concurrent systems bring multi-agent automation to medical data.
M 3 Builder [ 10 ] coordinates four role-playing agents over a structured medical imaging workspace, reporting model-building success rates on radiology datasets.
mAIstro [ 42 ] orchestrates eight task agents for radiomics and deep learning through a natural language interface.
AutoHealth [ 46 ] adds uncertainty estimation to autonomous health data modeling, and further frameworks target end-to-end clinical inference [ 38 ] and auditable model development [ 31 ] .
MedicalMLOmni is therefore not the first multi-agent AutoML system for medical imaging, and Tab. 1 states what distinguishes it from these systems.
Prior systems draw architectures, losses, and hyperparameters from templates, workspace resources, or LLM priors, whereas MedicalMLOmni grounds them in retrieved literature and reuses the same retrieval channel to drive hyperparameter refinement.
blocks.zh:
若干并行系统为医疗数据带来了多剂自动化。
M 3 Builder [10]在结构化的医学成像工作空间上协调四个角色扮演剂,报告放射学数据集的模型构建成功率.
mAIstro[42]通过自然语言界面,为放射学和深度学习组织8个任务代理.
AutoHealth [46] 在自主健康数据模型化中增加了不确定性估计,并进一步框架的目标是端到端临床推论[38]和可审计模型开发[31].
因此,MedicalMLOmni并不是第一个用于医疗成像的多剂AutoML系统,Tab. 1说明了它与这些系统有什么区别.
先前的系统从模板、工作空间资源或LLM前传中绘制架构、损失和超参数,而MedicalMLOmni将其置于检索文献中,再利用同一检索通道来推动超参数的改进。

blocks.en:
Retrieval augmentation is established for question answering, and LLM agents for code generation already plan, simulate, and debug their own programs [ 19 , 37 , 1 ] .
To our knowledge, applying retrieval to the configuration decisions of a training pipeline, and treating benchmark scores from the retrieved sources as the stopping criterion τ \tau , is not addressed by the systems above.

据我们所知,将检索应用于培训管道的配置决定,并将检索来源的基准分数作为停止标准\\ tau,以上系统没有处理。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of MedicalMLOmni showing evidence-based planning through literature retrieval, task-specific execution agents, and parallel hyperparameter optimization.
blocks.zh: 图1: MedicalMLOmni概览,通过文献检索,任务特定执行代理以及平行超参数优化,显示循证规划.

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 1 , MedicalMLOmni operates in two stages.
Given raw data 𝒟 \mathcal{D} (specified as the path to the data) and task description q q , the planning stage generates an evidence-based training plan π = ( 𝒜 , ℳ , ℒ , ℋ ) \pi=(\mathcal{A},\mathcal{M},\mathcal{L},\mathcal{H}) .
Specifically, 𝒜 \mathcal{A} identifies the task agent type that determines which implementation framework to use based on task type and data modality, ℳ \mathcal{M} defines the model architecture, ℒ \mathcal{L} selects the loss function, and ℋ \mathcal{H} contains model hyperparameters.
The execution stage implements π \pi through task-specific agents that generate and execute training code, producing trained model θ ∗ \theta^{*} , predictions y ^ \hat{y} , and validation metrics m m .
When m m fails to meet expected performance thresholds τ \tau specified in the planning stage, the parallel HPO refines π \pi through simultaneous literature-based hyperparameter adjustments.

具体来说, A\ mathcal{A} 识别任务代理类型, 以任务类型和数据模式决定要使用哪个执行框架, M\ mathcal{M} 定义模型架构, L\ mathcal{L} 选择丢失函数, H\ mathcal{H} 包含模型超参数 。

blocks.en:
The planning stage constructs π \pi through three agents that analyze task requirements, profile data characteristics, and retrieve evidence from the literature.
The query understanding agent prompts the LLM to parse q q by matching against pre-defined task taxonomies.
In parallel, the profiling agent generates Python scripts that traverse 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , inspect headers to detect data modality, and load samples to compute dataset properties such as count, dimensions, and memory requirements.
Together, the identified task type and the detected data modality determine 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , which routes to the appropriate implementation agent during execution.
The planning agent then constructs search queries by prompting the LLM to combine the extracted task type and data properties, submitting them to the search APIs [ 8 , 28 ] .
Retrieved results undergo LLM-based extraction to identify model architectures, loss functions, and hyperparameters.
Each configuration receives an LLM-calculated relevance score s ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s\in[0,1] that quantifies the alignment between the reported characteristics from the search results and the current data profile.
Instead of selecting a single source, the planning agent retrieves top- k k highest-scoring configurations to enable selective combination.
The planning agent then prompts the LLM to synthesize π \pi by selecting ℳ \mathcal{M} and ℒ \mathcal{L} from the highest-scored sources, while aggregating ℋ \mathcal{H} across multiple sources to incorporate complementary recommendations.
The agent also extracts performance thresholds τ \tau by prompting the LLM to identify validation metrics and benchmark scores reported for similar tasks and datasets in the retrieved results.
When no retrieved source reports a comparable benchmark, or when every source scores below s = 0.3 s{=}0.3 , τ \tau falls back to a fixed-budget schedule that triggers exactly one HPO round.
A failed retrieval therefore degrades the framework to a single blind refinement, not an unbounded loop.
Because τ \tau controls only when HPO fires and never enters the training objective, an over- or under-estimated τ \tau trades compute against accuracy and does not bias the final model.
Tab. 7 quantifies this sensitivity by perturbing τ \tau by ± \pm 10%.
MedicalMLOmni can optionally present π \pi with supporting evidence sources for user confirmation before execution.

blocks.en:
The execution stage routes to task-specific agents based on 𝒜 \mathcal{A} identified during planning.
Specifically, MedicalMLOmni instantiates vision task agents via MONAI [ 7 ] , text task agents via LLaMA-Factory [ 49 ] , and multimodal task agents via AutoMM [ 40 ] , and further agents can be registered for new task formulations.
The Qwen3-30B backbone acts only as the planning and code-generating agent; it never contributes weights to the trained model.
For VQA, the framework fine-tunes whichever vision-language model the plan selects through LLaMA-Factory , sharing no weights or pre-training with the Qwen3-VL baseline beyond both being publicly released checkpoints.
The output of each run is therefore an ordinary task model that can be deployed without the agent, and Tab. 6 reports what the same backbone achieves once the framework is removed.
Each task agent implements a five-step pipeline in which an LLM generates Python code conditioned on π \pi and the outputs from the preceding steps [ 19 ] .
The pipeline begins with the generation of data processing code, where the LLM generates scripts that load 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , apply transformations, and create train/validation/test splits if they are not available.
These scripts are executed to produce preprocessed data paths, which then condition the LLM to generate training code that instantiates ℳ \mathcal{M} with ℒ \mathcal{L} and ℋ \mathcal{H} from π \pi .
The training code runs in a sandbox environment with resource monitoring, producing checkpoint θ ∗ \theta^{*} and execution logs.
The sandbox is network-isolated and mounts 𝒟 \mathcal{D} read-only, so patient data never leaves the local execution environment.
Retrieval runs on a separate channel that transmits only the derived data profile (modality, voxel counts, class counts, and intensity statistics), never image content, filenames, or identifiers, keeping the online component free of protected health information.
Subsequently, the checkpoint path conditions the LLM to generate validation scripts that load θ ∗ \theta^{*} and compute metrics specified in π \pi .
Executing these validation scripts produces validation metrics m m and predictions y ^ \hat{y} , which are compared against thresholds τ \tau to determine whether HPO is needed.
When code execution fails at any step ( e . g ., out-of-memory errors, dimension mismatches), the LLM analyzes error messages and execution logs to generate corrected code [ 37 , 1 ] .
The LLM retrieves debugging strategies from online resources and incorporates these fixes into regenerated code.
This debugging process iterates with a maximum of five retry attempts before escalating to user review.

blocks.en:
When validation metrics m m fail to meet performance thresholds τ \tau extracted during planning, MedicalMLOmni initiates parallel HPO to refine the configuration.
Formally, MedicalMLOmni spawns n n HPO agents that independently explore hyperparameter modification strategies, each receiving the current plan π \pi , validation metrics m m , and execution logs as input.
Each HPO agent constructs literature search queries by prompting the LLM to combine underperforming metric names, current hyperparameter values from ℋ \mathcal{H} , and task properties, submitting them to the search APIs [ 8 , 28 ] used during planning.
HPO agents are prompted to focus on different hyperparameter categories such as optimization adjustments, regularization strategies, or architecture-specific parameters to ensure diverse exploration.
Retrieved results undergo extraction to identify adjustment strategies reported for similar tasks, which each agent scores based on relevance to the observed performance gap.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments

blocks.en:
We evaluate MedicalMLOmni across three categories of medical imaging tasks.
For segmentation, we assess performance on eight benchmarks that span various anatomical regions and imaging modalities:
AMOS [ 20 ] for multi-organ segmentation from CT and MRI; BraTS23 [ 23 ] and ACDC [ 6 ] for brain tumor and cardiac segmentation in MRI; KiTS23 [ 16 ] , BTCV [ 25 ] , TotalSegmentator [ 44 ] , and Touchstone [ 5 ] for kidney, abdominal organ, anatomical structures, and abdominal segmentation in CT; and MedSeg [ 24 ] for ultrasound, MRI, and X-ray segmentation.
For visual question answering, we evaluate on seven benchmarks: VQA-RAD [ 26 ] and GEMeX [ 30 ] for radiology X-ray, SLAKE [ 29 ] and PMC-VQA [ 48 ] for multilingual and multi-modal VQA; PathVQA [ 14 ] for pathology image analysis, MedXpertQA [ 50 ] for expert-level clinical assessment; and Kvasir-VQA [ 11 ] for gastrointestinal endoscopy analysis.
For multimodal fusion, we evaluate on five benchmarks: BraTS-Sur [ 4 ] , MIMIC [ 22 ] , and NLST [ 34 ] combine medical imaging with clinical data, text reports, and electronic health records for survival, mortality, and lung cancer risk prediction; ADNI [ 45 ] merges MRI and PET imaging for Alzheimer’s diagnosis; ISIC [ 12 ] fuses dermoscopic images with metadata for melanoma classification.
We report the Dice similarity coefficient for segmentation, accuracy for VQA, and task-specific metrics, namely accuracy, AUC, or pAUC (patient-level AUC) for multimodal benchmarks.
We use Qwen3-30B as the backbone.
The retrieval corpus is restricted to a frozen PubMed and arXiv snapshot (January 1, 2026) to ensure reproducibility and guard against contamination.

blocks.en:
Tab. 6 isolates the framework from the backbone by holding one factor fixed at a time.
Leaving Qwen3-30B to configure training from its prior yields 0.795 Dice, 59.3% accuracy, and rank 3.80, so MedicalMLOmni contributes 0.115 Dice and 8.4% accuracy over its own backbone, exceeding any margin over a specialized baseline.
Restoring planning without retrieval recovers most of that gap at 0.883 Dice and 63.4%, attributing the remaining 0.027 Dice and 4.3% accuracy to evidence.
Granting the strongest baseline a budget matched to our 18 GPU-hours lifts it from 0.891 to 0.898 Dice, narrowing our margin to 0.012, so a minority of the gap reflects unequal effort.
Against a domain expert configuring every benchmark manually, it slightly exceeds manual practice (0.910 vs. 0.901 Dice, 67.7% vs. 66.5%), the most relevant comparison for a system designed to replace that effort.
Swapping the backbone while holding the framework fixed shows that the gains are not Qwen3-specific.
Llama-3.3-70B and GPT-4o reach 0.907 and 0.914 Dice (68.2% and 69.5% VQA), within 0.003 Dice of or above the Qwen3-30B configuration, and even Qwen3-8B retains 0.885 Dice, above every AutoML baseline in Tab. 2 .
The framework therefore transfers across backbones and improves with stronger ones, allowing users to choose a backbone by licensing, latency, or cost without revalidating the framework.

blocks.en:
MedicalMLOmni is not uniformly strong; its two lowest-accuracy benchmarks reveal a consistent pattern.
On PMC-VQA it reaches 39.7% against 58.4% for Qwen3-VL, a gap of 18.7%.
On MedXpertQA it reaches only 31.2%, although this still leads the strongest baseline there, LLaVA-Med-v1.5, by 2.6%.
Both benchmarks reward broad parametric knowledge rather than a well-fitted task model.
PMC-VQA draws open-ended questions from a wide figure distribution, and MedXpertQA poses expert clinical reasoning that no literature-recoverable configuration can supply.
No single published task matches the question distribution of PMC-VQA, which is why it is the one benchmark we lose.
Evidence-based planning helps when the literature reports a comparable task with a transferable recipe, and contributes little when the bottleneck is knowledge the fine-tuned model never acquires.
An error analysis of 200 sampled failures on these two benchmarks reveals that only 18% stem from retrieval returning no comparable task.
A further 27% arise because the retrieved plan fits the wrong question format.
The majority (55%) are cases where the query requires clinical knowledge entirely outside the training data, confirming that planning cannot compensate for missing backbone knowledge.
These proportions suggest that expanding the backbone’s parametric coverage is a more effective next step than improving retrieval recall.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
MedicalMLOmni addresses clinical deployment challenges by automating DL training through evidence-based planning that retrieves configurations from the literature and parallel HPO that distributes searches across agents.
It achieves the best score on 19 of 20 benchmarks spanning segmentation, visual question answering, and multimodal fusion, outperforming both general-purpose and medical-specific AutoML methods.
By eliminating coding requirements and supporting diverse tasks through an extensible agent architecture, it lowers the barrier for domain experts with rich datasets but limited engineering expertise.
Future directions include incorporating institutional databases for local protocols, expanding modality coverage, and integrating retrieval-augmented generation to broaden the evidence base beyond published results.
blocks.zh:
MedicalMLOmni通过基于证据的规划将DL培训自动化,从而解决临床部署方面的挑战,这些规划从文献中检索配置,并平行地将搜索分布在特工之间。
它在20个基准中的19个基准上取得了最佳成绩,这些基准包括分解、视觉问答和多式联运聚变,优于通用和医学专用的自动ML方法。
通过消除编码要求和通过可扩展的代理架构支持多种任务,它降低了拥有丰富数据集但工程专业知识有限的域专家的屏障.
今后的方向包括:纳入地方协议的机构数据库,扩大模式覆盖面,整合检索强化生成,将证据基础扩大到已公布的成果之外。

blocks.en: S1 Significance Testing
blocks.zh: S1 意义测试

blocks.en:
The error bars reported throughout are propagated standard deviations over repeated runs and do not alone establish statistical significance.
We therefore add explicit hypothesis tests.
For the eight segmentation benchmarks, we compare MedicalMLOmni against nnU-Net using a paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test over per-case Dice scores, and report the p p -value together with a 95% bootstrap confidence interval for the mean difference.
The same procedure applies to the VQA and multimodal comparisons.
Each run uses a different random seed and repeats planning against the frozen snapshot, so no run reuses a cached plan.

在整个报告的错误栏中,对重复运行的标准偏差作了宣传,而不只是确定统计意义。
因此,我们增加明确的假设测试。
对于8个分区基准,我们用双侧的Wilcoxon签名排名测试比对每例Dice分数,将MedicalMLOmni与nnU-Net进行比较,并报告p-值与平均差值的95%的靴子置信间隔。
同样的程序适用于VQA和多式联运的比较。
每次运行使用不同的随机种子,重复针对被冻结的快照进行规划,因此没有运行重用缓存的计划.

blocks.en: S2 Baseline Adaptation Protocol
blocks.zh: S2 基线适应议定书

blocks.en:
The general-purpose AutoML systems in Tab. 2 and Tab. 3 of the main paper were not designed for volumetric segmentation or medical VQA, so the way they were adapted determines whether the comparison is fair.
For each system, we describe the input representation, the search space it was given, and the compute budget it received.
For AutoGluon and AutoKeras, 3D medical volumes were provided as 2.5D slice sequences.
For VQA tasks, answers were cast into textual generation or classification formats supported by their standard APIs.
Each system was restricted to its default model zoo and allowed up to 18 GPU-hours, matching MedicalMLOmni’s average budget, and finished within 10 to 15 GPU-hours (Fig. S1 ).
blocks.zh:
主论文的Tab. 2和Tab. 3中的通用自动ML系统不是为量子分割或医学VQA设计的,因此它们被调整的方式决定了比较是否公平.
对于每个系统,我们描述输入表示,给出的搜索空间,以及收到的计算预算.
对于AutoGluon和AutoKeras,3D医疗卷作为2.5D切片序列提供.
对于 VQA 任务,答案被刻制成文字生成或分类格式,由它们的标准API支持.
每个系统都被限制在其默认模式动物园内,并允许最多18个GPU小时,与MedicalMLOmni的平均预算相匹配,并在10至15个GPU小时(图S1)内完成.

blocks.en: S3 What Evidence-Based Planning Selects
blocks.zh: S3 循证规划选择

blocks.en:
The experiments above establish that retrieval improves performance without characterizing what it retrieves.
Tab. S2 fills this gap by recording the most common plan per task family, together with how often the synthesized plan matches the best published recipe for that benchmark.
Each task family shows a distinct pattern.
For segmentation, the retrieved plan converges on an nnU-Net-style configuration, and the gain comes mostly from preprocessing and schedule details, not from an unusual architecture, explaining why the margin over a budget-matched nnU-Net is the smallest we report.
For VQA, the plan converges on a parameter-efficient adaptation of a general vision-language backbone, and the gain tracks how close the retrieved task is to the benchmark, explaining why PMC-VQA, whose question distribution matches no single published task, is the one benchmark we lose.
For multimodal fusion, the literature is thinnest and the plans are most varied, yet the margin is largest because the baselines are themselves weakly tuned rather than because the retrieved plan is strong.
blocks.zh:
上面的实验证实,检索可以改善性能,而不说明检索的内容。
Tab. S2通过记录每个任务家族最常见的计划来填补这一空白,以及综合计划与该基准的最佳公布食谱的匹配频率.
每个任务家庭都呈现出不同的模式。
就分割而言,检索计划集中在nU-Net式的配置上,收益主要来自预处理和排程细节,而不是不寻常的架构,解释了为什么预算匹配的nU-Net的比值是我们报告的最小的.
对于VQA来说,计划就一般的视觉语言主干线的参数效率调整而趋同,并跟踪检索任务离基准有多近的增益,解释为什么PMC-VQA的提问分配与没有单一公布的任务相匹配,是我们失去的唯一基准.
对于多式聚变,文献较薄,计划也最为多样,但比值却最大,因为基线本身调节薄弱,而不是因为回收计划很强.

blocks.en: S5 Privacy and Sandbox Handling
blocks.zh: S5 隐私和沙盒处理

blocks.en:
Two components handle data that may be protected.
The sandbox executes generated code on the local machine with the dataset mounted read-only and outbound networking disabled, so training never transmits patient data.
The retrieval channel is the only outbound path.
It carries only the derived data profile (modality, voxel counts, class counts, and intensity statistics) together with the free-text task description supplied by the user; no image content, filenames, or patient identifiers leave the local machine.
Users retain responsibility for the task description they provide.
MedicalMLOmni can optionally run against a locally mirrored corpus, removing the outbound path entirely at the cost of corpus freshness.
blocks.zh:
两个组件处理可能受保护的数据。
沙盒在本地机器上执行生成的代码,并安装了只读和外出网络的数据集,因此训练从不传输病人数据.
检索通道是唯一的出入口路径.
它只携带衍生数据配置(模式、 voxel 计数、 类数和强度统计)以及用户提供的免费文本任务描述;没有图像内容、 文件名或病人标识符离开本地机器。
用户保留对其提供的任务说明的责任。
MedicalMLOmni可以选择性地对着一个当地镜像体运行,完全以体质新鲜为代价去除出行路径.

blocks.en: S6 Limitations
blocks.zh: S6 限制

blocks.en:
Three limitations follow from the design.
First, the framework inherits whatever the literature reports, so it cannot exceed published practice on tasks the literature does not cover, as the PMC-VQA result shows.
Second, planning quality depends on an external search service whose corpus evolves, so exact reproduction requires the frozen snapshot documented above, not a live API call.
Third, the evaluation covers public benchmarks whose characteristics are well represented in the literature, and performance on a private cohort with an unusual protocol remains untested.

设计中有三个限制。
首先,这个框架继承了所有文献报告,因此它不能超越文献未涵盖的任务的公开惯例,正如PMC-VQA结果所示.
第二,规划质量取决于外部搜索服务,其内容正在演变,所以精确的复制需要上面记载的被冻结的快照,而不是一个活的API呼叫.
第三,评价涵盖公共基准,其特征在文献中得到了充分体现,而且对有异常协议的私人群体的业绩仍未测试。
